subtasks.label: Hero Image with Back Button
subtasks.elements: ARCHETYPE: image-led — protagonist full-bleed workout photo 40% of screen, first screen 40%, photo bleeds under status bar, imagery single relevant full-bleed photo, no second hero, no overlaid titles here; floating circular back button (chevron left) top-left with translucent scrim, subtle bottom gradient fade into content area

subtasks.label: Title, Meta Row and Difficulty Badges
subtasks.elements: workout title (28px, two balanced lines), meta row with duration icon + value, calories icon + value, equipment icon + value, difficulty badges row of three pill badges (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced) with active state on Intermediate, owned by this section only

subtasks.label: Exercise List
subtasks.elements: quiet section: secondary visual weight; retain legible active states; section header 'Exercises' with count label (6), six exercise rows each with rounded thumbnail image, exercise name, sets × reps text on muted secondary line, thin divider between rows, list scrolls under pinned button

subtasks.label: Pinned Start Button
subtasks.elements: pinned bottom bar with soft top fade, full-width primary 'Start Workout' button (48px, rounded) with play icon, safe-area padding below
